== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1223]] is assessed at 87% (probable). The held Kirknewton/East Calder baptism account identifies Catherine Glasgow, 9 September 1805, as child of William Glasgow and Catherine/Catharine Nisbet. Repeated paired parents strongly identify the adult family, but William’s 1765 Swinton childhood lacks a direct adult bridge.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

Next useful test: Read the original baptism and parents’ marriage for William’s origin.

=== Cached source review, 24 October 2026 ===

The cached Findmypast transcript explicitly labels 19 August 1805 as Catherine’s birth, separate from the held 9 September 1805 baptism account. It names Wm Glasgow and Cath Nisbet at Mead Beek, Kirknewton & East Calder (OPR 690/3 item 2 p 47). This supports the existing child/event and fits the maintained before-9-September birth bound, which remains unchanged. Father Glasgow-1223 stays 87% probable; adult-profile placement and maternity remain qualified. The transcript supplies no baptism date.
